subject: Television & Streaming
title: AI and the Future of Television Writing
description: One-minute skill: AI and the Future of Television Writing.

hook.text: In 2023, Hollywood writers went on strike partly over AI. Studios wanted to use AI to generate scripts and outlines.

buildup.text: AI can already generate dialogue, plot outlines, and character descriptions.

discovery.text: The real threat isn't AI replacing writers—it's studios using AI to shrink staff and pay writers less to polish drafts.

twist.text: The 2023 strike settlement restricted AI use but didn't ban it.

climax.text: TV writing's future depends on whether the industry values human creativity as essential or treats it as a cost to cut.

punchline.text: The writers who tell human stories now fight to keep humans writing them.

quiz.question: What was the main concern about AI during the 2023 Hollywood writers' strike?
options: Studios would use AI to reduce writing staff and pay writers less for polishing AI-generated content
